summary: AVS ERP is an enterprise resource planning ecosystem tailored for the jewellery industry. Anonymous visitors are directed to the authentication portal, representing prospective clients or invited team members. Without an account, visitors can submit a demo request, activate an invitation code, initiate password recovery, and configure cookie preferences.
publicJourneys: Submit a product inquiry via Request Demo
Activate an account by submitting an invitation code via Accept Invitation
Initiate password recovery via Forgot Password
Switch between Standard Sign In and Sign In with OTP options
Configure cookie consent settings using Accept all, Essential only, or Manage options
